## Welcome to GitHub Copilot Enterprise Compliance Pro!

_GitHub Copilot Enterprise offers powerful AI-assisted development features, but maintaining compliance is key to a secure and legal codebase._

In this course, you will learn how to configure and monitor GitHub Copilot at an Enterprise level to ensure it meets your organization's regulatory and security standards.

### :keyboard: Activity: Start the course

To begin, simply refresh this page. GitHub Actions will detect that you've started the course and move you to Step 1.
